source_refs.note: Roman Urdu: practice mcqs written from Chapter 4 (PDF 90-125), not printed in the book; same questions and order as the English set. Drafts needing academic review.

blocks.text: Yeh chapter 4 (Computational Structures) ke poore chapter se practice MCQs hain, chapter ke sections ki tarteeb mein. Har sawal ka aik sahi jawab hai aur saath mukhtasar wajah; numerical sawalon mein hal ke qadam diye gaye hain.

blocks.prompt:
1 Computational structures such as lists, stacks and queues help us to:
(Lists, stacks aur queues jaise computational structures (hisabi dhanche) hamari kis kaam mein madad karte hain?)

options.text: data ko organize aur manage karna

blocks.explanation: Jaise hum rozana zindagi mein contacts ya plates tarteeb se rakhte hain, computer ko bhi data organize (tarteeb dena) aur manage karna hota hai; computational structures yahi kaam karte hain.

book_ref.quote: In our daily lives, we often need to organize and manage data

blocks.prompt:
2 Which of the following is NOT one of the computational structures studied in this chapter?
(In mein se kaun sa is chapter mein parhaya gaya computational structure NAHIN hai?)
blocks.explanation: Chapter mein lists, stacks, queues, trees aur graphs hain. Compiler aik program hai, data structure nahin.

book_ref.quote: we will explore key computational structures, such as lists, stacks, queues, trees, and graphs

blocks.prompt:
3 A data structure that stores multiple pieces of data in a specific sequence, each at a particular index, is called a:
(Woh data structure jo bohat se data ke tukre aik khaas tarteeb (sequence) mein rakhta hai, har aik apne index par, kya kehlata hai?)
blocks.explanation: List bohat se data ke tukre aik khaas tarteeb mein rakhti hai; har element apne index (maqam number) par hota hai.

book_ref.quote: A list is a data structure used to store multiple pieces of data in a specific sequence

blocks.prompt:
4 Each piece of data stored in a list is known as a(n):
(List mein rakhe gaye data ke har tukre ko kya kehte hain?)
blocks.explanation: List ke har data tukre ko element kehte hain aur woh aik khaas index par hota hai.

book_ref.quote: Each piece of data, known as an element, is positioned at a particular index

blocks.prompt:
5 In Python, a list is created by using:
(Python mein list kis cheez se banai jati hai?)
blocks.explanation: Python mein list square brackets '[]' se banti hai aur har item comma se alag hota hai.

book_ref.quote: In Python, Lists are created using square brackets

blocks.prompt:
6 In a Python list, the items are separated from each other by a:
(Python list mein items aik doosre se kis cheez se alag kiye jate hain?)
blocks.explanation: Har text item quotes mein hota hai aur items comma se alag kiye jate hain.

book_ref.quote: Each item is enclosed in quotes (for text) and separated by a comma

blocks.prompt:
7 What is the output of the following program?
bag = ["Pen", "Book", "Ruler"]
print(bag)
(Is program ka output kya hoga?)
blocks.explanation: print() poori list square brackets ke saath dikhata hai; Python text items ko single quotes mein dikhata hai.

book_ref.quote: The print () function is used to display the list

blocks.prompt:
8 Why are lists useful in a program?
(Program mein lists kyun mufeed hain?)

options.text: Yeh aik waqt mein sirf aik value rakhti hain
Yeh aik variable mein bohat si values rakhti hain
Yeh sirf numbers rakh sakti hain
Banne ke baad inhein badla nahin ja sakta

blocks.explanation: Lists aik variable mein bohat si values rakhne aur unhein achhi tarah manage karne ke liye mufeed hain; items add ya remove bhi ho sakte hain.

book_ref.quote: Lists are useful for storing multiple values in one variable

blocks.prompt:
9 In a linked list, each node contains:
(Linked list mein har node mein kya hota hai?)

options.text: do values aur koi reference nahin
aik value aur agle node ka reference

blocks.explanation: Linked list aik qism ki list hai jo nodes istemal karti hai; har node mein aik value aur agle node ka reference (hawala) hota hai.

book_ref.quote: where each node contains a value and a reference to the next node

blocks.prompt:
10 A Python list adjusts automatically when items are added or removed. This property is called:
(Items add ya remove karne par Python list khud ba khud adjust ho jati hai. Is property ko kya kehte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Dynamic Size: list apna size badal sakti hai; items add ya remove hone par khud adjust ho jati hai.

book_ref.quote: A list in Python can change its size

blocks.prompt:
11 In a Python list, the index of the first item is:
(Python list mein pehle item ka index kya hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: Index-Based Access: pehle item ka index 0, doosre ka 1, aur isi tarah aage.

book_ref.quote: The first item has an index of 0, the second item has an index of 1

blocks.prompt:
12 What is the output of the following program?
marks = [45, 67, 89, 72]
print(marks[2])
(Is program ka output kya hoga?)
blocks.explanation: Index 0 se shuru hota hai, is liye marks[2] teesra item yani 89 hai.

book_ref.quote: Every item in a list has a position, called an index

blocks.prompt:
13 If an item is added first to a list, it stays in that position unless you change it. Which property is this?
(Agar list mein koi item pehle add kiya jaye to woh usi jagah rehta hai jab tak aap use na badlein. Yeh kaun si property hai?)
blocks.explanation: Ordered Collection: jis tarteeb se items add hon woh tarteeb qaim rehti hai.

book_ref.quote: The order in which you add items to a list is preserved

blocks.prompt:
14 The list ["Ali", 17, 5.5, True] is an example of which list property?
(List ["Ali", 17, 5.5, True] list ki kaun si property ki misal hai?)
blocks.explanation: Heterogeneous Elements: list mein mukhtalif qism ke items (text, numbers waghera) aik saath reh sakte hain.

book_ref.quote: A list can hold different types of items together

blocks.prompt:
15 The property that lets you update, add or remove items after a list is created is:
(Woh property jis se list banne ke baad items update, add ya remove kiye ja sakte hain:)
blocks.explanation: Mutability (tabdeeli ki salahiyat): lists badli ja sakti hain; banne ke baad items update, add ya remove ho sakte hain.

book_ref.quote: Lists are changeable, meaning you can update, add, or remove items

blocks.prompt:
16 What is the output of the following program?
colours = ["red", "blue", "red", "green", "red"]
print(len(colours))
(Is program ka output kya hoga?)
blocks.explanation: List duplicates rakhti hai, is liye paanchon items (teen 'red' samait) maujood hain; len() 5 deta hai.

book_ref.quote: A list can contain the same item more than once

blocks.prompt:
17 A list that is kept inside another list is called a:
(Jo list kisi doosri list ke andar rakhi ho use kya kehte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Python mein lists nested ho sakti hain yani list ke andar list; yeh pecheeda data ke liye mufeed hai.

book_ref.quote: lists in Python can be nested, meaning you can have lists within lists

blocks.prompt:
18 What is the output of the following program?
items = ["Pen", "Book"]
items.append("Bag")
items.remove("Pen")
print(items)
(Is program ka output kya hoga?)
blocks.explanation: append() 'Bag' ko aakhir mein jorta hai aur remove() 'Pen' ko nikalta hai, baqi ['Book', 'Bag'] rehta hai.

book_ref.quote: We then demonstrate that lists can be changed by adding

blocks.prompt:
19 Which list function adds an item at a specific position?
(List ka kaun sa function kisi khaas jagah par item add karta hai?)
blocks.explanation: insert(position, item) se item kisi bhi jagah par dala ja sakta hai.

book_ref.quote: You can insert an item at any position in the list using the

blocks.prompt:
20 What is the output of the following program?
nums = [10, 20, 30]
nums.insert(1, 15)
print(nums)
(Is program ka output kya hoga?)
blocks.explanation: insert(1, 15) 15 ko index 1 par rakhta hai aur baqi items aik qadam aage ho jate hain: [10, 15, 20, 30].

book_ref.quote: Adding a new item to your list is like adding a new task to your to-do list

blocks.prompt:
21 Which list function adds several items at once to the end of a list?
(List ka kaun sa function aik hi baar kai items list ke aakhir mein jorta hai?)
blocks.explanation: extend() aik hi baar kai items jorta hai, maslan party_list.extend(['Party hats', 'Streamers']).

book_ref.quote: You can also add multiple items at once using the

blocks.prompt:
22 What is the output of the following program?
scores = [5, 3, 5, 7]
scores.remove(5)
print(scores)
(Is program ka output kya hoga?)
blocks.explanation: remove() sirf pehli dafa aane wala 5 nikalta hai, doosra 5 baqi rehta hai: [3, 5, 7].

book_ref.quote: function to delete the first occurrence of a specific item

blocks.prompt:
23 What is the output of the following program?
letters = ["x", "y", "z"]
letters.pop(1)
print(letters)
(Is program ka output kya hoga?)
blocks.explanation: pop(1) index 1 wala item ('y') nikal deta hai, baqi ['x', 'z'] rehta hai.

book_ref.quote: function to remove an item at a specific index

blocks.prompt:
24 After list.clear() is called, printing the list shows:
(list.clear() chalane ke baad list print karne par kya nazar aata hai?)
blocks.explanation: clear() list ke saare items nikal deta hai, is liye khaali list [] print hoti hai.

book_ref.quote: function to remove all items from the list

blocks.prompt:
25 What is the output of the following program?
tasks = ["Cook", "Clean", "Study"]
print("Shop" in tasks)
(Is program ka output kya hoga?)
blocks.explanation: in keyword dekhta hai ke item list mein hai ya nahin; 'Shop' list mein nahin, is liye False aata hai.

book_ref.quote: keyword to check if an item exists in the list

blocks.prompt:
26 What is the output of the following program?
days = ["Mon", "Tue", "Wed", "Thu"]
print(days.index("Wed"))
(Is program ka output kya hoga?)
blocks.explanation: index() item ki position batata hai; 0 se ginti karein to 'Wed' index 2 par hai.

book_ref.quote: function to find the position of an item in the list

blocks.prompt:
27 In the chapter's to-do list example, deleting an item from a list is compared to:
(Chapter ki to-do list misal mein list se item delete karna kis cheez jaisa hai?)

options.text: list ko naye safhe par naql karna
mukammal kiye gaye kaam ko kaat dena

blocks.explanation: Deletion aisa hai jaise mukammal kiye gaye kaam ko kaat dena; insertion naya kaam likhne jaisa hai.

book_ref.quote: Removing an item from your list is like crossing off a task

blocks.prompt:
28 Which of these is a searching algorithm that often operates on lists?
(In mein se kaun sa searching algorithm (talash ka tareeqa) aksar lists par kaam karta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Bubble sort aur selection sort data ko tarteeb dete hain (sorting); binary search data dhoondta hai (searching).

book_ref.quote: Algorithms like bubble sort, selection sort, and binary search often operate on lists

blocks.prompt:
29 When lists are used for matrix operations, each list represents:
(Jab lists matrix operations ke liye istemal hon to har list kis cheez ko zahir karti hai?)

options.text: matrix ki aik row ya column

blocks.explanation: Numerical aur scientific computing mein har list matrix ki aik row ya column hoti hai.

book_ref.quote: where each list represents a row or column of the matrix

blocks.prompt:
30 Which application of lists gives flexible handling of inputs in programming?
(Lists ka kaun sa istemal programming mein inputs ko lachakdar tareeqe se sambhalta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Lists aksar functions ko kai arguments bhejne ke liye istemal hoti hain, jis se inputs aasani se sambhalte hain.

book_ref.quote: Lists are often used to pass multiple arguments to functions

blocks.prompt:
31 In a stack, insertion and deletion of elements take place at:
(Stack mein elements ka insertion aur deletion kahan hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: Stack mein items sirf aik siray, yani top, se add ya remove hote hain.

book_ref.quote: Both insertion and deletion of elements occur at this top end

blocks.prompt:
32 A stack operates on which principle?
(Stack kis usool par kaam karta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Stack LIFO par chalta hai: sab se aakhir mein dala gaya element sab se pehle nikalta hai.

book_ref.quote: meaning that the most recently added element is the first one to be removed

blocks.prompt:
33 The stack property that items can be added or removed only at the top is called:
(Stack ki woh property jis mein items sirf top se add ya remove hote hain:)
blocks.explanation: Single Access Point: stack mein items sirf top se add ya remove hote hain.

book_ref.quote: You can only add or remove items from the top of the stack

blocks.prompt:
34 According to the size flexibility property, a stack:
(Size flexibility property ke mutabiq stack:)

options.text: hamesha muqarrar size ka hota hai
muqarrar size bhi ho sakta hai ya zaroorat par barh sakta hai
sirf do items rakh sakta hai

blocks.explanation: Size Flexibility: stack ka size muqarrar bhi ho sakta hai ya zaroorat ke mutabiq barh bhi sakta hai.

book_ref.quote: A stack can either have a fixed size or grow as needed

blocks.prompt:
35 In a stack, items can be accessed only in the order they were added, starting from the top. This is:
(Stack mein items sirf usi tarteeb se, top se shuru kar ke, hasil hote hain jis mein dale gaye. Yeh kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Sequential Access: items sirf dalne ki tarteeb mein, top se shuru kar ke, hasil kiye ja sakte hain.

book_ref.quote: You can only access items in the order they were added, starting from the top

blocks.prompt:
36 When a Python list is used as a stack, which list function performs the push operation?
(Jab Python list ko stack ke taur par istemal karein to push operation kaun sa list function karta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Push stack ke top par item jorta hai; list mein yeh kaam append() karta hai.

book_ref.quote: Push means adding an item to the top of the stack

blocks.prompt:
37 What is the output of the following program?
stack = []
stack.append(1)
stack.append(2)
stack.append(3)
print(stack.pop())
(Is program ka output kya hoga?)
blocks.explanation: 3 sab se aakhir mein push hua, is liye top par hai; pop() use nikal kar wapas deta hai (LIFO).

book_ref.quote: We use list pop() function to remove the element from the top of the stack

blocks.prompt:
38 What is the output of the following program?
shelf = ["Book A"]
shelf.append("Book B")
shelf.append("Book C")
shelf.pop()
shelf.append("Book D")
print(shelf)
(Is program ka output kya hoga?)
blocks.explanation: 'Book C' (top) pop hoti hai, phir 'Book D' 'Book B' ke upar push hoti hai.

book_ref.quote: Here is a Python implementation of the book stack described above

blocks.prompt:
39 Which real-life example is used in the chapter to explain a stack?
(Chapter mein stack samjhane ke liye kaun si rozmarra misal di gayi hai?)

options.text: bank ke aage logon ki qataar

blocks.explanation: Mez par kitabon ke dhair mein aap sirf upar kitab rakh sakte ya upar se utha sakte hain.

book_ref.quote: you can only add a book on top of the stack or take the top book off

blocks.prompt:
40 Stacks help manage the nodes to be explored in which graph traversal algorithm?
(Stacks kis graph traversal algorithm mein nodes ko sambhalne mein madad karte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Stacks DFS mein istemal hote hain; woh visit hone wale nodes ko LIFO tareeqe se sambhalte hain.

book_ref.quote: stacks are used in algorithms like depth-first search (DFS) in graph traversal

blocks.prompt:
41 Which of the following is NOT listed as a use of stacks in computers?
(In mein se kaun sa computer mein stack ka istemal NAHIN bataya gaya?)
blocks.explanation: Stacks expressions hal karne, function calls, parentheses balance karne aur undo mein kaam aate hain; print spooling queue se hoti hai.

book_ref.quote: function call management, balancing parentheses and undo mechanism

blocks.text: 4.1.3.1 Infix, Postfix, and Prefix Notations; Converting an Infix Expression to Postfix

blocks.prompt:
42 In which notation is the operator placed between the operands, as in A + B?
(Kis notation mein operator operands ke darmiyan hota hai, jaise A + B?)
blocks.explanation: Infix notation mein operator operands ke beech hota hai; yeh aam hisab ka tareeqa hai.

book_ref.quote: Infix Notation: The operator is placed between the operands

blocks.prompt:
43 Postfix notation is also called:
(Postfix notation ko aur kya kehte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Postfix ko Reverse Polish Notation (RPN) kehte hain; prefix ko Polish Notation.

book_ref.quote: Postfix Notation (Reverse Polish Notation, RPN)

blocks.prompt:
44 In prefix (Polish) notation, the operator is placed:
(Prefix (Polish) notation mein operator kahan hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: Prefix notation mein operator operands se pehle aata hai, jaise +AB.

book_ref.quote: Prefix Notation (Polish Notation): The operator is placed before the operands

blocks.prompt:
45 The postfix form of the infix expression P - Q is:
(Infix expression P - Q ki postfix shakal kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Postfix mein operator operands ke baad aata hai, is liye P - Q ban jata hai PQ-.

book_ref.quote: The operator is placed after the operands. This notation does not require parentheses

blocks.prompt:
46 The prefix form of the infix expression X * Y is:
(Infix expression X * Y ki prefix shakal kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Prefix mein operator operands se pehle aata hai: *XY.

book_ref.quote: Like postfix notation, prefix notation also does not require parentheses

blocks.prompt:
47 While converting infix to postfix with a stack, what is done with an operand?
(Stack se infix ko postfix mein badalte waqt operand ke saath kya kiya jata hai?)

options.text: Use stack par push kiya jata hai
Woh right parenthesis milne tak intezar karta hai
Use seedha output list mein dala jata hai

blocks.explanation: Operand milte hi seedha output list mein dal diya jata hai; operators stack se guzarte hain.

book_ref.quote: If you find an operand, add it directly to the output list

blocks.prompt:
48 During infix to postfix conversion, when a right parenthesis is found, operators are popped to the output until a left parenthesis is found. The left parenthesis is then:
(Infix se postfix banate waqt right parenthesis milne par operators left parenthesis tak output mein pop hote hain. Phir left parenthesis ke saath kya hota hai?)

options.text: output list mein dal diya jata hai
dobara stack par push hota hai
stack se hata diya jata hai magar output mein nahin dala jata
output ke shuru mein chala jata hai

blocks.explanation: Left parenthesis stack se hata diya jata hai magar output mein nahin dala jata; postfix ko parentheses ki zaroorat nahin.

book_ref.quote: Remove the left parenthesis from the stack but do not add it to the output list

blocks.prompt:
49 Using the stack method of the chapter, the infix expression (P - Q) * R is converted to postfix as:
(Chapter ke stack tareeqe se infix expression (P - Q) * R ki postfix kya banegi?)
blocks.explanation: ( push hota hai, P aur Q output mein, - push; ) aane par - output mein (P Q -). Phir * push, R output mein, aakhir mein * pop: P Q - R *.

book_ref.quote: pop operators from the stack to the output list until you find a left parenthesis

blocks.prompt:
50 While converting 3 * 4 + 2 to postfix, the + is read when * is on the stack. What happens?
(3 * 4 + 2 ko postfix mein badalte waqt + parha jata hai jab stack par * hai. Kya hota hai?)

options.text: + ko * ke upar push kar diya jata hai
* output mein pop hota hai, phir + push hota hai
+ seedha output mein chala jata hai
* aur + dono chhor diye jate hain

blocks.explanation: * ki priority + se zyada hai, is liye + push karne se pehle * output mein pop hota hai. Natija 3 4 * 2 + hai.

book_ref.quote: if there is already an operator on the stack with higher or equal priority

blocks.prompt:
51 Using the stack method, the infix expression 5 + 6 * 2 is converted to the postfix:
(Stack tareeqe se infix expression 5 + 6 * 2 ki postfix kya hogi?)
blocks.explanation: 5, 6 aur 2 output mein; + push hota hai, phir * us ke upar (zyada priority). Aakhir mein stack pop: pehle * phir +, yani 5 6 2 * +.

book_ref.quote: When you have processed the entire infix expression, pop any remaining operators

blocks.prompt:
52 Using a stack, the value of the postfix expression 2 3 4 * + is:
(Stack ki madad se postfix expression 2 3 4 * + ki value kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: 2, 3, 4 push karein. * par 4 aur 3 pop: 3 * 4 = 12, push. + par 12 aur 2 pop: 2 + 12 = 14.

book_ref.quote: When you find a number, push it onto the stack.

blocks.prompt:
53 Using a stack, the value of the postfix expression 6 2 - 3 * is:
(Stack ki madad se postfix expression 6 2 - 3 * ki value kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: 6, 2 push. - par 2 aur 6 pop: 6 - 2 = 4, push. 3 push. * par 3 aur 4 pop: 4 * 3 = 12.

book_ref.quote: pop the required number of items from the stack, perform the operation

blocks.prompt:
54 While evaluating 7 8 2 * +, what does the stack contain just before * is read?
(7 8 2 * + hal karte waqt * parhne se theek pehle stack mein kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Expression baen se daen parha jata hai aur har number push hota hai: [7], [7, 8], [7, 8, 2].

book_ref.quote: Read the expression from left to right.

blocks.prompt:
55 After a postfix expression has been fully evaluated with a stack, the answer is:
(Postfix expression stack se poori hal hone ke baad jawab kya hota hai?)

options.text: sab se pehle push hone wala number

blocks.explanation: Stack par bacha aakhri natija hi jawab hai, maslan 3 4 5 * + ke liye [23].

book_ref.quote: The final result on the stack is the answer to the expression.

blocks.prompt:
56 When a function finishes running, what happens to its details on the stack?
(Jab function chal kar khatam ho jaye to stack par us ki details ka kya hota hai?)

options.text: Woh stack se pop ho jati hain
Hamesha ke liye reh jati hain

blocks.explanation: Function call hone par us ki details stack par likhi jati hain; khatam hone par pop ho jati hain.

book_ref.quote: When the function finishes, it removes (or pops) its details from the stack

blocks.prompt:
57 In the phone-call example, writing a name on top of the notepad when you make a call is like:
(Phone call ki misal mein call karte waqt notepad ke upar naam likhna kis jaisa hai?)
blocks.explanation: Call karna (upar naam likhna) push jaisa hai; call khatam karna (naam kaatna) pop jaisa.

book_ref.quote: This is like pushing information onto the stack.

blocks.prompt:
58 Which of these expressions does NOT have balanced parentheses?
(In mein se kis expression ke parentheses balanced NAHIN hain?)
blocks.explanation: ((5 + 1) * 2 mein aik opening parenthesis ka jora nahin, is liye aik ( stack par bacha rehta hai.

book_ref.quote: every opening parenthesis has a matching closing parenthesis

blocks.prompt:
59 While checking (9 - 3)) with a stack, the second ) tries to pop from an empty stack. The result is:
((9 - 3)) ko stack se check karte waqt doosra ) khaali stack se pop karna chahta hai. Natija kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Agar khaali stack se pop karne ki koshish ho to parentheses balanced nahin.

book_ref.quote: or if you try to pop from an empty stack, the parentheses are not balanced

blocks.prompt:
60 When checking parentheses with a stack, which symbol is pushed onto the stack?
(Stack se parentheses check karte waqt kaun sa nishan stack par push hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: Stack opening parentheses ka hisab rakhta hai: ( push hota hai aur ) top ko pop karta hai.

book_ref.quote: Use a stack to keep track of opening parentheses.

blocks.prompt:
61 The undo feature of text editors such as Notepad and Microsoft Word is implemented with a:
(Notepad aur Microsoft Word jaise text editors ka undo feature kis se banaya jata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Har action stack par mehfooz hota hai; undo sab se taaza action stack se nikal kar ulat deta hai.

book_ref.quote: Each action you perform is saved on a stack

blocks.prompt:
62 A user types "Good", then "Morning", then "Pakistan". Pressing undo twice removes:
(User pehle "Good", phir "Morning", phir "Pakistan" type karta hai. Do baar undo dabane se kya hatega?)
blocks.explanation: Undo sab se taaza action pehle pop karta hai: pehle 'Pakistan', phir 'Morning'.

book_ref.quote: If you continue to press undo, each previous action is reversed

blocks.prompt:
63 A line of people at a ticket counter, where the first to join is the first served, represents which data structure?
(Ticket counter ki qataar, jahan pehle aane wala pehle farigh hota hai, kis data structure ko zahir karti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Queue bank ya ticket counter ki qataar jaisi hai: pehle aane wala pehle farigh (FIFO).

book_ref.quote: The first person to get in line is the first person to be served

blocks.prompt:
64 In a queue, items are added at the ______ and removed from the ______.
(Queue mein items ______ par add aur ______ se remove hote hain.)
blocks.explanation: Bank ki qataar ki tarah cheezein peeche (back) add aur aage (front) se remove hoti hain (FIFO).

book_ref.quote: you add things to the back and remove them from the front

blocks.prompt:
65 The queue property that it adjusts automatically to the number of items it holds is:
(Queue ki woh property jis mein woh items ki tadaad ke mutabiq khud adjust hoti hai:)
blocks.explanation: Dynamic Size: items add ya remove hone par queue barh ya ghat sakti hai.

book_ref.quote: A queue can grow or shrink in size as you add or remove items

blocks.prompt:
66 Which is a key property of a queue?
(Queue ki aik aham property kaun si hai?)
